- Spontaneous awakening at 3–4 AM  
- Fully refreshed upon awakening, no significant sleep inertia

- Elevated melatonin in early evening (objective biomarker of circadian phase advance)  
- Actigraphy (7–14 days) confirms stable, phase-advanced sleep–wake pattern  
- Chronic duration (>3 months) and stability since retirement from day-shift work

Advanced Sleep–Wake Phase Disorder
